title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 8: Emiko Furukawa
native_title: プラドル・ディスク Ｖｏｌ．８ ～古川恵美子～
overview:
An 18-year-old active on many fronts: singing, acting, and gravure! Everything about Emiko Furukawa, all in one disc!!

Volume 8 of the Private Idol Disc series is a photo collection and quiz disc starring Emiko Furukawa, with photography by Kazuo Ito. Browse her photo album, learn more about her through an interview of 100 questions, and play mini games including a "look this way" game and a quiz.

- Photo Hall: photo album
- 100 Questions: Q&A interview
- Game Hall: "look this way" and a quiz
- Production credits

歌、演技、グラビアと多方面で活躍中の18歳!古川恵実子のすべてを収録!!
